reason: Both conversations correctly identify 22E as a fridge-fan fault, most likely from ice, and recommend a full unplugged defrost with engineer escalation if the code returns. Conversation 2 also deals with the 9C fridge reading by giving food-safety advice, avoids heat guns and hairdryers, and tells the customer to check warranty status first. Conversation 1 never raises warranty, gives no food-safety guidance for the warm fridge, and has garbled, truncated text (missing list items, a cut-off sentence). It does make better use of the ticking and frost clues and answers the freezer question well. Conversation 2 loses a little for speculative forced-defrost button advice and for overclaiming that a defrost plus seal fix clears 22E 'for good'.
